title: Arabic MSA 25K — Saudi Male (Tashkeel)
title_ar: مجموعة بيانات العربية الفصحى 25 ألف - صوت ذكوري سعودي بالتشكيل
description_en: A 25,000-clip Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) speech corpus with fully diacritized text (tashkeel). All audio synthesized by a single Saudi male neural voice (ar-SA-HamedNeural) at 48 kHz, 16-bit mono PCM WAV, totaling ~60.5 hours. Text generated by GPT-4o-mini with strict MSA rules and full tashkeel. Covers 10 balanced thematic categories (technology, science, health, news, etc.). Useful for TTS fine-tuning, ASR training, diacritization evaluation, and prosody research.
description: 25K Arabic MSA speech clips with full tashkeel, Saudi male TTS voice, 60.5h total audio, 10 categories.
description_ar: مجموعة بيانات صوتية للعربية الفصحى بالتشكيل الكامل، 25,000 مقطع صوتي بصوت ذكوري سعودي.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, speech processing, arabic, msa, tashkeel, speech, TTS, ASR

title: TAWNZA_TIFINAGH_ARABIC_DATASET
description_en: A parallel translation corpus of 132,000 subtitle lines from the Moroccan TV show TAWNZA, with Arabic source text and Standard Moroccan Tamazight (Tifinagh script) translations. Includes timing metadata (start, end, duration). Covers 70% of the total show data across multiple seasons and episodes. Useful for Arabic-Tamazight machine translation, low-resource NLP, and Berber language processing. Also includes audio in three Amazigh dialects (Tachelhit, Tarifit, Tamazight).
description: 132K Arabic-Tamazight parallel subtitle pairs from Moroccan TV show TAWNZA, with timing metadata.
description_ar: مجموعة ترجمة متوازية بين العربية والأمازيغية بخط تيفيناغ من برنامج تاونزا المغربي.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, machine translation, arabic, tamazight, tifinagh, translation, low-resource

entities.dialect: Modern Standard Arabic, Standard Moroccan Tamazight

title: hindawi-arabic-sections
title_ar: مجموعة بيانات مقاطع كتب هنداوي العربية
description_en: A cleaned section-level dataset of 52,830 sections from 3,265 Arabic books sourced from Hindawi.org. Covers 25 categories including literature, philosophy, history, science, psychology. Cleaning pipeline includes: removal of English/Latin text, tashkeel, tatweel, letter normalization, exact and near-duplicate deduplication. Split into train (90%), validation (5%), test (5%). Total 843 million characters. Mean section length: 15,973 chars. Available under Hindawi Foundation free-access agreement.
description: 52,830 cleaned Arabic book sections from 3,265 Hindawi books, 843M chars, 25 categories.
description_ar: مقاطع من كتب هنداوي العربية المنظفة والمحررة للبحث والتدريب في معالجة اللغة الطبيعية.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, language modeling, arabic, books, hindawi, text-corpus, nlp

title: english-arabic-speech-translation
description_en: A large parallel speech translation dataset of 302,067 rows pairing English audio clips (from Common Voice) with Arabic text translations. Contains three splits: train (260K), validation, and test. Fields include audio, English source sentence, and Arabic translation. Useful for speech-to-text translation (ST), Arabic ASR with translation, and cross-lingual NLP research.
description: 302K English audio clips paired with Arabic translations from Common Voice, for speech translation.
description_ar: مجموعة بيانات ترجمة صوتية ضخمة تجمع مقاطع صوتية إنجليزية مع ترجمات عربية.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, speech processing, arabic, english, speech-translation, ASR, common-voice

title: Falcon-Arabic-7B-Instruct-details
title_ar: تفاصيل تقييم فالكون العربي 7B المضبوط على التعليمات
description_en: Evaluation benchmark results for the Falcon-Arabic-7B-Instruct model, containing 93,411 multiple-choice Arabic questions with model predictions, logits, and accuracy metrics. Questions cover diverse Arabic topics in multiple dialects (MSA, Moroccan Arabic, etc.). Released by Technology Innovation Institute (TII) as part of the Falcon-Arabic model family evaluation. Useful for benchmarking Arabic LLMs.

title_en: ArabicText-Large: High-Quality Arabic Corpus for LLM Training
title: ArabicText-Large
title_ar: مجموعة النصوص العربية الكبيرة لتدريب النماذج اللغوية
description_en: A comprehensive high-quality Arabic text corpus of 743,288 articles with over 244 million words, curated for LLM training. Sourced mainly from Arabic Wikipedia. Covers 9 topic categories (History, Science, Geography, Biography, Arts, Politics, Religion, Sports). Multi-stage cleaning pipeline: artifact removal, normalization, quality filtering (min 70% Arabic content), deduplication. 94.2% Arabic content purity, 1.5 million unique words. Apache 2.0 license.
description: 743K Arabic Wikipedia articles, 244M words, 94.2% purity, multi-stage cleaned for LLM training.
description_ar: مجموعة نصوص عربية كبيرة وعالية الجودة من 743,288 مقالة و244 مليون كلمة לتدريب النماذج اللغوية.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, language modeling, arabic, llm, nlp, text-corpus, wikipedia, modern-standard-arabic

entities.tasks: language modeling, LLM pretraining, text classification

title_en: Muharaf — Arabic Handwritten Text Recognition Dataset
title: Arabic-Handwritten-Text-Recognition-Dataset
title_ar: مجموعة بيانات التعرف على الخط العربي اليدوي - مُحارف
description_en: A re-upload of the Muharaf dataset for Arabic handwritten text recognition, containing 457 images of handwritten Arabic manuscripts with ground truth transcriptions. Covers historical Arabic cursive script, including 19th and early 20th century letters, articles, poems, and official documents. Useful for OCR on historical Arabic documents. Split into train (273), validation, and test. Published at NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks Track.
description: 457 Arabic handwritten manuscript images with transcriptions (Muharaf dataset, NeurIPS 2024).
description_ar: مجموعة مُحارف للتعرف على الخط العربي اليدوي في المخطوطات التاريخية.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, OCR, arabic, OCR, handwritten, manuscripts, historical

title_en: Mushroom Hunting Arabic LLM — Adversarial Hallucination Benchmark
title: Mushroom-Hunting-Arabic-LLM
title_ar: مجموعة صيد الفطر - معيار الهلوسة التوليدية للنماذج العربية
description_en: An adversarial red-teaming dataset of 4,250 Arabic prompt-answer pairs designed to trigger factual hallucinations in Arabic LLMs. Created for the Elm NLP Challenge (MenaML Winter School 2026). Uses Layered Adversarial Stacking: implicit false premises, temporal anachronisms, semantic ambiguity, cross-domain category mixing, and statistical near-misses. Covers factual/historical (45%), infrastructure (20%), linguistic (15%), logical (10%), and meta-cognitive (10%) categories. MIT license.
description: 4,250 Arabic adversarial prompts to trigger LLM hallucinations, red-teaming benchmark for Arabic AI.
description_ar: مجموعة بيانات هجومية لكشف الهلوسات في النماذج اللغوية العربية، 4,250 سؤال وجواب.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, large language models, arabic, adversarial, red-teaming, hallucinations, LLM, benchmark

title: arabic-ocr-synthetic-scans-faker-300k
title_ar: مجموعة بيانات المسح الضوئي الاصطناعي للعربية - 300 ألف صورة
description_en: A large-scale synthetic dataset of 300,000 Arabic book page images generated to mimic real-world scanning imperfections. Uses 10 Arabic fonts (Amiri, Traditional Arabic, Sakkal Majalla, Scheherazade, etc.) across 6 layout types (single/dual column, index, poetry, title page). Physics-based optical degradation (light/moderate/heavy). Ground truth text includes XML structural tags. Rich metadata: font, layout, noise level, and 15 boolean content flags. CC-BY-4.0 license.
description: 300K synthetic Arabic book page scans with OCR ground truth, 10 fonts, 6 layouts, 3 noise levels.
description_ar: 300,000 صورة اصطناعية لصفحات كتب عربية مع نص مرجعي للتعرف الضوئي على الحروف.
keywords: natural language processing, arabic nlp, OCR, document understanding, arabic, ocr, synthetic, document-understanding, VLM
